tools.name: email_claim_status_notice
tools.description: Sends an email to a policyholder telling them the current status of their claim.

params.name: status_text
params.description: Status message to include in the email

tools.code:
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

from langchain_core.tools import tool


@tool
def email_claim_status_notice(claim_id: str, to_address: str, status_text: str) -> str:
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = "claims@examplinsurance.com"
    msg["To"] = to_address
    msg["Subject"] = f"Update on your claim {claim_id}"
    msg.set_content(f"Hello,\n\nRegarding claim {claim_id}:\n\n{status_text}\n\nClaims Department")
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.examplinsurance.com", 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(msg)
    return f"Status notice for {claim_id} sent to {to_address}."

tools.name: archive_closed_claim_to_storage
tools.description: Uploads a closed claim's file package to the long-term archive bucket and removes the local copy from the working claims folder.

params.name: claim_id
params.description: Claim identifier whose package should be archived

tools.code:
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass

import boto3
from langchain_core.tools import tool

_s3 = boto3.client("s3")
_BUCKET = "insurer-claims-archive"
_WORK_DIR = "/var/claims/working"


@dataclass
class ArchiveResult:
    claim_id: str
    s3_key: str
    archived: bool


@tool
def archive_closed_claim_to_storage(claim_id: str) -> dict:
    local_path = os.path.join(_WORK_DIR, f"{claim_id}.zip")
    key = f"closed/{claim_id}.zip"
    if not os.path.isfile(local_path):
        return ArchiveResult(claim_id, key, False).__dict__
    _s3.upload_file(local_path, _BUCKET, key)
    os.remove(local_path)
    return ArchiveResult(claim_id, key, True).__dict__
